test_cases.name: happy_path_fresh_execution_mutation_commit
test_cases.description: First-time execution of mutating operation with unseen key acquires lock, executes tool, persists receipt, and commits output.
test_cases.input: Execute mutating operation create_invoice on resource /invoices with idempotency key idem-inv-001.
expected_output_patterns: === IDEMPOTENCY FILTER INGEST: Key: idem-inv-001 Op: create_invoice ===

test_cases.name: duplicate_call_returns_cached_replay
test_cases.description: Duplicate invocation with matching idempotency key and payload returns cached response receipt without re-executing operation.
test_cases.input: Execute duplicate mutating operation create_invoice on resource /invoices with idempotency key idem-inv-001 and identical payload.
expected_output_patterns: === IDEMPOTENCY FILTER INGEST: Key: idem-inv-001 Op: create_invoice ===

test_cases.name: concurrent_operation_in_flight_rejection
test_cases.description: Concurrent request arrives while operation for key is actively IN_PROGRESS, rejecting with OPERATION_IN_FLIGHT.
test_cases.input: Execute mutating operation process_payment with key idem-pay-888 while key status is IN_PROGRESS.

test_cases.name: payload_mismatch_detection
test_cases.description: Key reuse with differing payload parameters violates payload integrity, triggering IDEMPOTENCY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH defect.
test_cases.input: Execute operation set_permission with key idem-perm-101 but with altered role payload from initial commit.

test_cases.name: stale_lock_force_released_and_recovered
test_cases.description: Invocation finds in-progress lock exceeding timeout, force-releasing stale lock and proceeding with lock acquisition.
test_cases.input: Execute operation provision_server with key idem-srv-909 where existing IN_PROGRESS lock timestamp is older than lock_timeout_ms.
expected_output_patterns: [STALE_LOCK_RELEASED] Key: idem-srv-909 Force releasing orphaned lock

test_cases.name: mutation_failure_marking
test_cases.description: When underlying operation throws an exception, journal records status FAILED with error details and propagates error.
test_cases.input: Execute mutating operation charge_card with key idem-chg-303 where gateway returns card declined exception.
